mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing output contraction that reduces corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that trigger Federal Reserve tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.0% quarterly signals strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.
